definitions.gloss: prevailing view; accepted theory; common interpretation
definitions.explanation: A widely held opinion or established interpretation within a field. Often used in academic, legal, or historical contexts to refer to the mainstream view as opposed to minority or revisionist positions.

examples.japanese: {通説|つうせつ}では{否定|ひてい}されている。
examples.english: It is rejected by the prevailing view.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}については{通説|つうせつ}と{異|こと}なる{見解|けんかい}もある。
examples.english: There are also views on this issue that differ from the accepted theory.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{発見|はっけん}により、{長年|ながねん}の{通説|つうせつ}が{覆|くつがえ}される{可能性|かのうせい}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: A new discovery has raised the possibility that the long-standing accepted theory may be overturned.

notes:
Used in academic and intellectual discourse to refer to the mainstream or consensus position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通説|つうせつ}に{従|したが}う (follow the accepted theory)
- {通説|つうせつ}を{覆|くつがえ}す (overturn the prevailing view)
- {通説|つうせつ}に{反|はん}する (go against the prevailing view)
- {通説|つうせつ}では (according to the prevailing view)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{定説|ていせつ} is a more firmly established theory that is considered settled fact, while {通説|つうせつ} is the currently prevailing view that may still be debated.
